name: shuffleplus
description: Shuffle+ 11.8.0 — Tests navigateur réels : Chromium, WebKit/iPhone et validation PWA.

scripts.check: node scripts/check-js.mjs && node scripts/check-version.mjs && node scripts/check-imports.mjs && node scripts/check-security.mjs && node scripts/check-css-architecture.mjs && node scripts/check-pwa-shell.mjs && node scripts/check-e2e-architecture.mjs && node scripts/check-release-readiness.mjs && node scripts/check-readme.mjs && node scripts/check-release-cleanup.mjs
scripts.test: npm run check && node --test tests/*.test.mjs && npm --prefix server test
scripts.validate: npm test && npm run build && npm run check:dist && npm run smoke
scripts.release:check: npm run validate && npm run test:e2e
